faq_section_question_1: What is .NET MAUI and how does it benefit me?
faq_section_answer_1: .NET MAUI (Multi-platform App UI) is a cross-platform framework for creating native mobile and desktop apps with C# and XAML. It allows you to write code once and deploy it across Android, iOS, Windows, and macOS. This means faster development times, reduced costs, and a consistent user experience across all platforms.
faq_section_question_3: What happens if I exceed the application limit in my current plan?
faq_section_answer_3: If you exceed the application limit in your current plan, you will need to upgrade to a higher-tier plan that supports more applications.
faq_section_question_4: Can I cancel or change my plan at any time?
faq_section_answer_4: Yes, you can cancel or change your plan at any time. If you decide to upgrade or downgrade your plan, the changes will take effect immediately, and your billing will be adjusted accordingly. If you cancel, you will retain access to your current plan’s features until the end of the billing cycle.
faq_section_question_2: How long does it take to generate an app using your platform?
faq_section_answer_2: The time it takes to generate an app depends on the complexity of the project. However, our platform is designed to streamline the process, allowing you to create a functional app in just a few seconds. More complex customizations may take longer, but our intuitive interface ensures a swift development process.
